summary: Bandai Namco's weapon-based fighting series, from Soul Edge through Soulcalibur VI, including major ports and service/spinoff releases.

emulation.notes: Use PlayStation emulation with increased internal resolution.

primary.why: The PlayStation release, titled Soul Blade outside Japan, adds the home modes/content and is the most complete route for the first game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation version with DuckStation at increased internal resolution.

entries.title: Soulcalibur

emulation.notes: Use Dreamcast emulation if not on hardware.

primary.why: The Dreamcast version added features and improved graphics beyond the arcade version, making it the core complete route; later mobile/Xbox 360 routes are useful but availability varies.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Dreamcast version on hardware or Flycast/Redream.

entries.remaster_caveats: Some later digital ports were delisted; verify availability before relying on them.

entries.title: Soulcalibur II
entries.definitive_edition: Soulcalibur II HD Online plus GameCube/Switch 2 secondary for Link

emulation.notes: Use HD Online where available; use Dolphin or Switch 2 Nintendo Classics for Link.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: HD Online / GameCube emulation for Link route

primary.why: HD Online adds HD visuals and online play and includes Heihachi and Spawn together, making it the fidelity route; the GameCube/Switch 2 route is secondary for Link.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soulcalibur II HD Online on PS3/Xbox 360 if owned; play the GameCube/Switch 2 version only for Link.

secondary.exclusive_content: Link as a playable guest character.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the GameCube/Switch 2 version for Link-specific arcade/multiplayer sessions.
secondary.why: HD Online includes Heihachi and Spawn but not Link; the Nintendo version preserves that exclusive guest.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD Online lacks Link and may have digital availability caveats.

entries.title: Soulcalibur III

emulation.notes: Use PS4/PS5 release; PCSX2 remains a fallback for the original PS2 disc.

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release up-renders the PS2 game and adds emulator conveniences, making it the highest-fidelity official home route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soulcalibur III on PS4 or PS5 from the PlayStation Store / Classics catalog.

secondary.exclusive_content: Arcade Edition balance/tuning and arcade-specific revision.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample Arcade Edition if competitive tuning comparison matters.
secondary.why: Arcade Edition is a re-tuned revision that differs from the PS2 home-content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Arcade Edition changes are not folded into the PS2 home-content route.

emulation.notes: Use increased internal resolution and motion-control mapping.

primary.why: Legends is a Wii-only action-adventure spinoff; Dolphin gives it the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soulcalibur Legends with Dolphin at increased internal resolution and a suitable motion-control setup.

entries.title: Soulcalibur IV

emulation.notes: Use original hardware or compatible emulation.

primary.why: Soulcalibur IV is a PS3/Xbox 360 release with no later port identified; use the best available HD console route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soulcalibur IV on PS3/Xbox 360 hardware or compatible emulator.

entries.remaster_caveats: Guest-character/DLC availability may vary by platform and storefront state.

emulation.notes: Use PS4/PS5 release; PPSSPP remains a fallback for PSP.

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 release enhances the PSP game with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and video filters, making it the current official fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny on PS4 or PS5 from the PlayStation Store / Classics catalog.

emulation.notes: Use original hardware or compatible emulation.

primary.why: Soulcalibur V is a PS3/Xbox 360 release with no later port identified; use the best available HD console route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soulcalibur V on PS3/Xbox 360 hardware or compatible emulator.

entries.title: Soulcalibur: Lost Swords

primary.why: Lost Swords was a free-to-play PS3 service title that shut down in 2015; the final service build is the authentic version.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route remains after service closure; preserve through archival documentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service closure prevents normal official play.

entries.title: Soulcalibur: Unbreakable Soul

primary.why: Unbreakable Soul was an iOS mobile service title that was discontinued; the final mobile build is the authentic version.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route remains after service closure; preserve through archival documentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service closure prevents normal official play.

primary.why: Soulcalibur VI released on PS4, Xbox One, and Windows; PC provides the highest configurable fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Soulcalibur VI on Windows/Steam with current patches and desired DLC.
